elements.element: Preferred: no non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire ... any of the other party's personnel" — a non-solicit continues to bind the Company.

elements.element: Fallback: restriction is mutual (binds both parties)
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall ... solicit for hire ... any of the other party's personnel"

elements.element: Fallback: scope limited to personnel directly involved in the Services
elements.evidence: "personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services"

elements.element: Fallback: duration limited to 12 months measured from the end of that person's involvement
elements.evidence: "during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination" — measured from Agreement termination, not from the end of the individual's involvement; unchanged by the redline.

elements.element: Fallback: carve-out for general advertisements / non-targeted recruiting
elements.evidence: "(a) placing general advertisements or conducting other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or hiring any person who responds thereto"
"(b) hiring any person who approaches such party on an unsolicited basis"
Prohibition is limited to "solicit for hire"; the carve-outs expressly permit "hiring any person who responds thereto" and unsolicited hires.

offending_extra_words: or conducting other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or hiring any person who responds thereto
which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
reasons: Fallback fails on duration: the tail runs for the whole Agreement term plus one year after termination, rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement with the Services. A short operator edit (e.g. replacing the trigger with "for twelve (12) months after the end of that individual's involvement with the Services") was available and was not made, so the level is incomplete.
Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is plainly not achieved — the mutual restriction still binds the Company.

Scope, mutuality, no-hire absence and both carve-outs are satisfied on the face of the text; the official literal patterns for 'direct involvement' and 'unsolicited approach' miss the drafted wording, but the operative language is express.

Minimality fails: the insertion re-anchors on "which shall not be unreasonably withheld." and expands 6 words to 51, and adds a broader exception for "other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted" beyond the two carve-outs the level requires; a standalone concise sentence covering only general advertisements and unsolicited approaches would suffice.
Intent is preserved: no undefined terms, no contradiction, and the consent mechanic and mutual structure remain effective.
